## Caveats

* **Synthetic data.** Every row is generated by `make seed`. Volumes, distributions and KPI values are modelled, not measured.
* **KPI names and thresholds are UNVERIFIED.** They follow standard RAN practice (accessibility via RRC/E-RAB setup success, retainability via drop rate, integrity via throughput and latency, utilisation via PRB) but each operator defines its own counters. Reconcile with the real counter definitions before any live use.
* **Legacy-technology KPIs are generous on purpose.** The thresholds are LTE-shaped, so seeded 2G/3G cells are given baselines that sit just inside them. Real legacy cells would breach an LTE throughput or latency threshold permanently; per-technology thresholds are needed before live use.
* **No raw subscriber identifiers exist in this schema.** `subscriber.id` is an HMAC pseudonym; columns marked PII are masked by default in the explorer and in exports.
